correctness.rationale: A nonsplit F2 quadric has two conjugate geometric rulings. Smooth degree four would give a genus-one E with #E(F2)=5 and hence #E(F4)=5, forcing all degree-two Picard classes over F4 to be rational; the distinct conjugate ruling classes cannot both be Frobenius-fixed. The explicit quadric–cubic is geometrically smooth by unit-ideal Gröbner bases on all four projective charts; its 5 F2-points are direct finite checks. Smoothness and ample connectedness imply geometric integrality.
